record.question: Commutation money means:
options: Commutation money is the refundable security deposit retained by the government from the pensioners retirement benefits to transfer settlement of outstanding dues
Commutation money is the lump sum amount payable to a pensioner in the exchange for surrender a portion of the pension for the period prescribed under the pension rules
Commutation money is a monthly allowance granted to a retired employee who opts to differ the commencement of his or her pension beyond the date of retirement
Commutation money is the annual gratuity paid to a pensioner in lieu of the dearness relief foregone during the previous financial
